body.statement: Fix \((Q,P)\in\mathcal M_{L,\eta}\) and \(h\in\ker(A_P)\). The support-tangent right inverses produce \(\Delta^h\) with zero total mass and one-way marginal increment \(d^h\). Moreover \(\varepsilon_*(h)>0\), because every nonzero coordinate of \(\Delta^h\) lies on a positive atom of the finite kernel \(K\). For every \(|\varepsilon|<\varepsilon_*(h)\), \(Q^{\varepsilon,h}\in\mathcal M_{L,\eta}\) has observed law \(P\), the same latent support, proxy kernels, and assignment mechanism as \(Q\), admits bridge \(g+\varepsilon h\), and has target \(\theta(Q^{\varepsilon,h})=\theta(Q)+\varepsilon R_0h\).
body.justification: This is the load-bearing causal lift: it turns every algebraic null direction into actual indistinguishable causal laws.
body.gap: Proposition 2.3 of \cite{ZhangLiMiaoTchetgen2023} varies statistical solutions to an integral equation but does not construct finite full-data laws preserving an entire trial network and latent contrast restrictions. The support-tangent formulation also avoids assuming positivity of unneeded joint potential-outcome atoms.
body.consumer: It certifies that a failed nullspace test in a proximal evidence network reflects genuine causal ambiguity, not an artifact of bridge parametrization.
